mapper.select: SELECT actor_id,payload_json FROM audit_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND application_id=#{applicationId} AND aggregate_type='Task' AND action IN ('APPROVE','RETURN','REJECT','TRANSFER','DELEGATE','RESOLVE','ADD_SIGNER','REMOVE_SIGNER')

SELECT e.id,e.aggregate_id,e.application_id,e.action,e.occurred_at,e.payload_json, a.business_no,a.title,a.process_key,a.definition_version,a.status FROM audit_event e JOIN approval_application a ON a.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND a.id=e.application_id WHERE e.tenant_id=#{argument1} AND e.actor_id=#{argument2} AND e.aggregate_type='Task' AND e.action IN ('APPROVE','RETURN','REJECT','TRANSFER','DELEGATE','RESOLVE','ADD_SIGNER','REMOVE_SIGNER') AND e.action=#{argument3} AND (LOWER(a.title) LIKE #{argument4} ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(a.business_no) LIKE #{argument5} ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(a.process_key) LIKE #{argument6} ESCAPE '!') AND (e.occurred_at<#{argument7} OR (e.occurred_at=#{argument8} AND e.id<#{argument9})) ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC,e.id DESC LIMIT #{argument10}
